The `heap_insert` function is part of the PostgreSQL database management system responsible for inserting new tuples (rows) into "heaps", which refer to regular tables in PostgreSQL.

**Location:**  
The function `heap_insert` is found within the **"src/backend/access/heap/"** directory, specifically inside **`heapam.c`**, one of the key files dealing with heap access methods.
